Each issue is drafted by an AI assistant following a fixed search protocol, then reviewed by me before it is published. See [how this newsletter is made](about.qmd). It also goes to the [GenAI SABER SIG](/docs/genai/community/index.qmd) listserv, and you can follow new issues in any feed reader, with no signup.
